key_points: Spider-Man: Brand New Day box office nearing Avengers: Endgame opening record, indicating strong film performance.
Streaming and Experiences divisions reported to carry the quarter and lift outlook per Kalkine.ca.
Disney announced third wave of layoffs, continuing cost‑cutting after earlier 300 tech/HR job cuts.
Potential collaboration with Bluey creator cited as a strategic content opportunity.
Analyst pieces suggest stock may be ~19% undervalued due to CTO/AI initiatives, but these are commentary rather than new fundamentals.
